M04.name: Q/A orphan rule removed
by: a question never ends a page without its answer (Q&A orphan rule)

M11.name: safe-area check disabled
by: broken image -> P18 FAIL; safe-area violation -> P21 WARNING; short bleed -> P23 WARNING

M12.name: image resolution check disabled
by: low image resolution: <100ppi FAIL, <200ppi WARNING

M13.name: bleed-box check disabled
by: wrong trim size -> P11 FAIL; invalid bleed (BleedBox == TrimBox) -> P12 FAIL

M14.name: blind pack leaks the flatplan
by: publication:all on the sample issue: PDF, page PNGs, contact sheets, critic pack, preflight

M15.name: contents overflow check removed (validate)
by: CONTENTS_OVERFLOW / LAYOUT_OVERFLOW are errors, raised from the measured layout probe

M16.name: contents completeness check removed (preflight)
by: contents entry lost -> P31 FAIL; orphan lines -> P29 WARNING (heuristic); under-filled page -> P30 WARNING (heuristic)

M17.name: publishing boundary: not-ignored check removed
by: private issue inside the work tree and NOT ignored => FAIL
validate / build / all REFUSE an issue that private source would make public; the override is explicit

M18.name: manuscript HTML passes through unescaped
by: manuscript HTML is escaped, never executed: script/style/iframe/object/embed/on*=/javascript:/remote image
safe Markdown: allowed element list is exactly what the renderer can emit

M19.name: image URL percent-encoding removed
by: asset names with Japanese, spaces, "\#", parentheses render in build, render and PDF

M20.name: Chromium sandbox disabled by default
by: Chromium sandbox policy: on by default, off only explicitly or in the managed root container

M21.name: theme external-resource check removed
by: theme CSS cannot load remote resources

M22.name: critic --reset overwrites authored reviews
by: --reset REFUSES while any review holds work, and changes nothing
--reset --force archives every review file (timestamped) before writing empty templates

M23.name: stale reviews gate the new output
by: reviews are bound to the output: matching source_hash is fresh, anything else is stale and does not gate
preflight P27: no review -> MANUAL CHECK; stale review -> MANUAL CHECK; fresh review with open HIGH -> FAIL

M24.name: page-relative token replaced by a millimetre literal
by: tokens.css defines the three families and page-relative margins (no mm margins)

M25.name: density heuristics return nothing
by: accidental sparseness is flagged; declared intent (with a reason) is not; quote/photo pages never are

M26.name: orphan-line measurement disabled
by: orphan lines: a last line of one or two characters is reported, a full last line is not

M27.name: undefined grid helper class (c-1-5 removed)
by: every grid helper class used by a component (c-1-5, c-all, …) is defined in the theme
